description: Found scaffolding without a guardrail near tank 4; contractor was standing on it while no harness was worn.
Electrician worked on 415V MCC feeder without applying lockout tagout padlock as isolation switch was stiff.
Observed weeping valve gland packing with continuous hydrocarbon gas hiss on high pressure wellhead Christmas tree at 3000 PSI.
Roughneck was standing directly in rotary table swing radius while drill string was being hoisted under heavy tension.
Two contract workers entered crude oil storage tank for sludge cleaning without gas test clearance and no continuous ventilation.
Unsecured heavy flange wrench fell from derrick monkey board 18 meters above rig floor, landing 1 meter from driller console.
Contractor observed standing on top of crude storage tank roof without safety harness or fall arrest lanyard attached to lifeline.
Crane sling showed frayed steel strands while lifting 3-ton drill collar over active work area on pipe deck.
H2S portable gas monitor alarmed at 15 PPM near wellhead manifold; operator continued work without donning escape BA set.
Maintenance crew entered low-pressure separator vessel with manway cover open but without atmospheric oxygen test and no standby attendant.
Operator positioned himself in line of fire of pressurized mud hose with missing whip-check safety cable during pump startup.
Thermal relief valve on condensate discharge line failed to seat, releasing flammable vapor cloud near boiler area.
Technician climbed up the derrick mast ladder without engaging the fall arrestor sleeve on the safety climb cable.
Casing pipe rolled off storage rack toward pedestrian walkway because stop chocks were not placed on pipe rack tier.
Mechanic started dismantling pump impeller on crude dispatch pump while suction valve was not positively isolated and tag not placed.
Welder grinding pipe support inside fabrication yard without wearing full face shield, using only safety spectacles.
Technician handling hydrocarbon solvent during pump overhaul without chemical resistant nitrile gloves, skin contact noted.
Loose electrical extension cord trailing across walkway near workshop bench creating a tripping hazard near power tools.
Fire extinguisher in chemical storage bay had inspection tag overdue by 3 weeks, pressure gauge still in green zone.
Safety helmet chin strap unfastened while operating vibrating shaker screen in drilling mud area.
Crane hook safety latch spring was weak and did not close automatically unless pushed manually by rigger.
Small water puddle noticed near administrative corridor entrance due to AC drain overflow in office building.
Office pantry trash bin was overflowing with empty paper tea cups and cardboard snack packets.
Cardboard carton boxes stacked in photocopier room corner obstructing spare paper ream rack.
Defective ceiling tube light flickering in 2nd floor finance department hallway.
Slight oil smudge observed on outer casing of parked non-operational tractor in open grass yard.
